title: The Levite and His Concubine

questions.question: Where did the Levite take a concubine from?
questions.explanation: Judges 19:1 (ESV): "...he took to himself a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah."

questions.question: Where did the concubine go when she was angry with him?
options: Back to her father's house in Bethlehem
questions.correctAnswer: Back to her father's house in Bethlehem
questions.explanation: Judges 19:2 (ESV): "...and went away from him to her father's house at Bethlehem in Judah..."

questions.question: How long did the Levite stay at his father-in-law's house?
questions.explanation: Judges 19:4-8 (ESV): The father-in-law detained him each day until the fifth day.

questions.question: Which city did the Levite refuse to enter?
questions.explanation: Judges 19:11-12 (ESV): "...we will not turn aside into the city of foreigners..."

questions.question: Where did they decide to spend the night instead?
questions.explanation: Judges 19:14 (ESV): "...and the sun went down on them near Gibeah..."

questions.question: Who took them in for the night in Gibeah?
options: An old man from the hill country of Ephraim
questions.correctAnswer: An old man from the hill country of Ephraim
questions.explanation: Judges 19:16 (ESV): "And behold, an old man was coming from his work in the field..."

questions.question: What did the men of the city (worthless fellows) demand?
options: Bring out the man who came into your house, that we may know him
questions.correctAnswer: Bring out the man who came into your house, that we may know him
questions.explanation: Judges 19:22 (ESV): "...Bring out the man who came into your house, that we may know him."

questions.question: Who did the host offer instead?
options: His virgin daughter and the Levite's concubine
questions.correctAnswer: His virgin daughter and the Levite's concubine
questions.explanation: Judges 19:24 (ESV): "Behold, here are my virgin daughter and his concubine. Let me bring them out now..."

questions.question: What happened to the concubine?
options: They abused her all night until morning
questions.correctAnswer: They abused her all night until morning
questions.explanation: Judges 19:25 (ESV): "...and they knew her and abused her all night until the morning..."

questions.question: What did the Levite do with his concubine's body?
options: Cut her into twelve pieces and sent her throughout all the territory of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Cut her into twelve pieces and sent her throughout all the territory of Israel
questions.explanation: Judges 19:29 (ESV): "...took a knife... and cut her into twelve pieces, limb by limb, and sent her throughout all the territory of Israel."

questions.question: How many servants did the Levite have with him?
questions.explanation: Judges 19:3 (ESV): "...having his servant and a couple of donkeys with him."

questions.question: Why did the Levite not want to enter Jebus?
options: Because it is a city of foreigners, who do not belong to the people of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Because it is a city of foreigners, who do not belong to the people of Israel
questions.explanation: Judges 19:12 (ESV): "...We will not turn aside into the city of foreigners, who do not belong to the people of Israel..."

questions.question: When the Levite found his concubine at the door in the morning, was she dead or alive?
options: The text implies she was dead (she did not answer)
questions.correctAnswer: The text implies she was dead (she did not answer)
questions.explanation: Judges 19:28 (ESV): "And he said to her, 'Get up, let us be going.' But there was no answer..."

questions.question: Where did the Levite plan to go specifically ("house of the Lord" or "my house")?
options: House of the Lord (in some translations) / My home
questions.correctAnswer: House of the Lord (in some translations) / My home
questions.explanation: Judges 19:18 (ESV): "...I am going to the house of the LORD..." (Note: Some texts say "my house", but ESV says house of the LORD).

questions.question: What was the reaction of everyone who saw the pieces?
options: Such a thing has never happened or been seen from the day that the people of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: Such a thing has never happened or been seen from the day that the people of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt
questions.explanation: Judges 19:30 (ESV): "And all who saw it said, 'Such a thing has never happened or been seen...'"

key_verse_text: And all who saw it said, “Such a thing has never happened or been seen from the day that the people of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt until this day...” (ESV)
